programs.description: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.
A WWI veteran becomes a postman and delivers letters and money orders to the families of soldiers. However, his visits soon turn into a bad omen when WWII breaks out.
Pandian falls in love with his neighbour, Maithili, and anonymously helps her continue her education. However, Pandian's roommate, Prakash, gets all the credits for his good deeds.
While looking to borrow money to meet his wife's medical expenses, Durgaprasad uncovers a deadly terrorist plot and must act to save the city from destruction.
A man sets out to investigate the death of his brother at a haunted house, leading him to come across several supernatural experiences.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.
Ajayan comes back to his village to be with his ailing mother. However, things get strange when a boy comes to his house claiming to be his son.
When 18 children are abducted and found dead, Mark, a police officer, races to catch the criminals. With only 18 hours left, he must confront powerful foes and use unconventional tactics to succeed.
Madhavan is an honest and hardworking man. However, when a rich man's daughter, Eliana, asks him to abduct her and demand a ransom from her father, his life turns upside down.

Prakashan, after drinking, encounters Vinod and a young woman near a carpenter's abode. Subsequently, both men, Prakashan and Venu, perceive this duo as an affectionate couple, suspecting the woman is Nirmala.

Kichu is a heartless student leader who can go to any extent for power. He is asked to donate his blood to save a man named Krishnan, whose story changes him for the better.
Debt-ridden Govinda convinces a suicidal, rich Suryan to live for a year so he can profit from Suryan's insurance policy. However, Suryan falls in love with Govinda's daughter and wants to live.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
A young man's cross-country trip with his landlord's grandmother propels him into a journey of unexpected experiences and self-discovery.
With Isha by his side, DJ Shiva rises to a crescendo of love and fortitude to embrace his role as the chosen protector of the universe's most powerful weapon.
Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.
Gopan, a tourist guide, issues a statement against his rival, Kuriyachan, regarding a human trafficking case. However, Kuriyachan seeks revenge against Gopan.
The life of struggling news anchor, Engels Ramaswamy, and his family changes when a goddess appears before them. Later, with the help of the goddess, Engels sets out to expose fake godmen.
Ali Bhai, a goon, is the saviour of the poor in his dominion, Palayam market. However, when his enemies try to take over the market, he goes to great lengths to protect his stronghold and his people.

The lives of four friends Romario, Riyas, Yoodas and Athmaram, take a dramatic turn when a girl joins their mechanical engineering class.
Vinaychandran, a writer, makes a living by selling his average romantic stories. His life takes a turn when he is assumed to be an expert on matters of the heart while trying to help a professor.
An uneducated and noisy simpleton, Mike Philippose, arrives in a city as an organ donor for an old astrophysicist. Soon, he changes the lives of everyone around him.
Mathukutty, Zachariah and Binoy, whose fathers were friends twenty years ago, return to Goa in order to reclaim a casino. But they face many challenges when a local goon tries to plot against them.
Anandakkuttan's life as a young artist takes a dramatic turn when he takes his autistic brother under his wing, leading to an unexpected yet heartwarming bond between them.
After a past incident, two powerful clans of Krishnapuram remain estranged until one day, a man with a mysterious past decides to bring the families together.
After the COVID-19 pandemic hits Sri Lanka, a family travels to India to begin a new life. Their arrival quickly transforms their new neighbourhood.
Following a mysterious phone call and a death, the lives of 12 friends, who are at a bachelor's party, hang in the balance, while an inebriated policeman races to unravel the mystery.

In the 1960s, when her father passed away, Suma Aachar's conservative household turned upside down as she had to shoulder the family's responsibilities and navigate her dreams while discovering herself.

Sethunath is a successful writer who shares the story of his life with journalist Aneesa. He talks about falling in love with Priya and his inability to marry her because of his estranged wife, Manju.
Lakshmanan, an advocate specialising in women's divorce cases, ties the knot with Annie. However, trouble ensues when her hidden agenda emerges.
Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
Monayi goes to the city to stay with his friend. However, he ends up getting involved in problems which turns chaotic for everyone.
David and Sara's marriage fails due to an unexpected turn of events. Years later, they continue to love one another and also strive to prove Sara's sister's innocence in a murder case.
When his father dies, Chandran is forced to go abroad to earn money to pay his father's dues. On a holiday to India, he meets his childhood lover and hopes to rekindle the relationship.
While Siddhu and Karthi's mother single-handedly raises them, she harbours annoyance against her sons. Their relationship is tested when some traumatic experiences draw them closer to each other.
When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.
Gauri accidentally kills a wealthy businessman to stop him from molesting a little girl. When his minions chase after her and her husband, they must hide until the proof to exonerate them is found.

Vidyadharan, a clockmaker and widower, lives only for his daughter. However, his life takes a turn for the worse when he kills a thug, whom he suspected of murdering a village girl.
The lives of a taxi driver, a man travelling to Kerala and a public prosecutor intertwine with each other as they seek monetary aid and justice.
The passionate dream of becoming musicians comes to a standstill for a group of college students when their main singer falls in love.
Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
Teja Bhai, a gangster falls in love with Vedhika, a simple girl. He has to leave his criminal life behind in order to seek her father's consent to marry her.
Franco, who runs an automobile workshop, and his sister Jenny, a college student, share a very strong bond. Matters take a turn when Franco falls in love with Jenny's enemy.

Apoorvan, a school dropout, aspires to become a renowned scientist and tries various experiments. While his friends Babumon and Chopra help him, the three often land in trouble due to their behaviour.
Pulikkattil, an affluent family man, is forced to bear the brunt and burden of his late father's unscrupulous past. Now, Karnan, a jail convict, decides to settle some old scores with him.
Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

Irshad and Haseeb, two teenage boys from Mattanchery, share a passion for pigeon flying, a local game. Later, Irshad opens up about a tragic incident that ruined many friendships in the neighbourhood.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Neil, a showroom executive, finds a bag full of money after a party. Later, he receives a call to meet at a secluded spot where he finds four strangers and gets involved in a dangerous deal.
Kalasadhan Ullas is an aspiring stage singer looking for his big break. However, his life is turned upside down when an opportunistic woman and her father target him for a nefarious purpose.
Chaos ensues after two reality show finalists compete against each other in a challenge in order to win a huge cash prize.
Lal Krishna, an eccentric criminal lawyer, defends the woman accused of Chinthamani's murder. However, he learns that there is more to the story and decides to dispense justice in his own way.
Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.
Kanan falls in love with Raddhu, the daughter of a ruthless city gangster responsible for numerous deaths. To marry her, Kanan must confront the dangers and challenges that lie ahead.
Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

Vrinda, a rich young woman, falls in love with Vasu, a poor man. However, he rejects her advances due to his financial status.

Rajan, a policeman, goes after a powerful criminal but ends up losing his wife and is also left crippled. Soon, he becomes a jailer and recruits four vigilantes to trap the kingpin who ruined his life.
Agricultural officer Sachithanandan and his wife Shyama's life changes after the husband's womanising friend Jose visits for a few days.
After being misunderstood as a pervert in his village, Rajakumaran moves to Kochi to start life afresh. There, his life changes when he meets Manjari and Manjima.
The disastrous floods in Kerala in 2018 bring about fatal implications for every individual. Later, people from different backgrounds cooperate to weather the disaster.
When her spouse, Manu, gets kidnapped, Indu approaches her confidante Sagar for succour. Soon, Sagar goes to Goa to save Manu and gets entangled in a lethal game.
A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.
Velayudhan, an orphan, is loved by the villagers as he keeps the village free from unsavoury people and practices. However, an evil moneylender and politician get jealous and try to get rid of him.
A young man suffering from a hearing defect rises up against a corrupt local leader along with the help of his fearless older brother. Together, they defy tyranny in a fight for justice and freedom.

Raghu, a responsible youth, faces the wrath of the villagers as he is the son of a lazy postman. However, Raghu's life takes a turn when he encounters Yasin Mubarak, a notorious man.
A newly married woman tries to become an ideal wife and daughter-in-law to her traditional and patriarchy family. Eventually, their growing demands and disrespect cause rifts between them.
Prabhakaran, a Gandhian panchayat member, fights corruption in Thonnurkara village. However, his crusade for people's welfare angers corrupt politicians.
Chandradas, a renowned poet, accidentally meets his estranged teenaged daughter, Harita. After coaxing her, he takes her to his ancestral home, but she starts missing her stepfather.
In the year 1983, the emotional fixation of a young man with his Maruti 800 car gets tested when he falls for his childhood confidante.
Sreehari has returned home from Paris after six years. He tries to settle some scores and clear misunderstandings with his old friends before leaving his village.
A man's first day on the job turns into a nightmare after some vengeful spirits begin to create trouble by trapping him in an elevator.
Joseph Alex and Bharathchandran, two police officers, try to prevent Major Abu Jalal Rana, a terrorist, from attacking New Delhi.
Struggling to pay for his mother's surgery, an unemployed lawyer resorts to illegal means to make money. However, as greed takes over, he goes to great lengths to become rich.
